```{r}
# 本脚本用于比较临床诊断与量表结果的混淆矩阵以及ROC曲线
# 数据来源：
# Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label.xlsx
# （已完成：ID 去重 + 病历诊断标签匹配）
#
# 分析流程与检出率分析保持一致：
# - 数值转换
# - 原始数据 -1
# - 反向计分
# - 年龄限制（7–18 岁）

# ============================================================
# 0) Packages
# ============================================================
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pROC)
library(papaja)
library(patchwork)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)
# ============================================================
# 1) 数据读取与预处理（与前面保持一致）
# ============================================================

clinroc_raw_data <- read.xlsx(
  here("DATA", "Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label.xlsx")
)

clinroc_raw_data <- clinroc_raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = factor(Gender, levels = c("男", "女"), labels = c(1, 2))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(matches("Gender|Age|DSRSC|PHQ|DASS|CDI"), as.numeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(Age >= 7 & Age <= 18)

# 年龄描述统计
clinroc_age_summary <- clinroc_raw_data %>%
  summarise(
    Age_mean = round(mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Age_sd   = round(sd(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Age_min  = round(min(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Age_max  = round(max(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  )

cat("\n年龄描述统计：\n")
print(clinroc_age_summary)

# 原始数据 -1
clinroc_raw_data <- clinroc_raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(matches("DSRSC|PHQ|DASS|CDI"), ~ .x - 1)
  )

# 反向计分
clinroc_cdi_reverse_items <- c(
  "CDI2", "CDI5", "CDI7", "CDI8", "CDI10",
  "CDI11", "CDI13", "CDI15", "CDI16",
  "CDI18", "CDI21", "CDI24", "CDI25"
)

clinroc_dsrsc_reverse_items <- c(
  "DSRSC3", "DSRSC5", "DSRSC6", "DSRSC10",
  "DSRSC14", "DSRSC15", "DSRSC17", "DSRSC18"
)

clinroc_ready_data <- clinroc_raw_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(clinroc_cdi_reverse_items), ~ 2 - .)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(clinroc_dsrsc_reverse_items), ~ 2 - .))

# 量表总分（与前面保持一致；CDI26 不计入总分）
clinroc_ready_data <- clinroc_ready_data %>%
  mutate(
    total_DSRSC = rowSums(select(., starts_with("DSRSC")), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_PHQ   = rowSums(select(., starts_with("PHQ")),   na.rm = TRUE),
    total_CDI   = rowSums(select(., starts_with("CDI")),   na.rm = TRUE) - CDI26,
    total_DASS  = rowSums(select(., starts_with("DASS")),  na.rm = TRUE)
  )

cat("用于 ROC / cutoff 验证分析的样本量：", nrow(clinroc_ready_data), "\n")
print(table(clinroc_ready_data$Depression_status))
# ============================================================
# 2) 构建真实标签与固定 cutoff 预测
# ============================================================

clinroc_eval_data <- clinroc_ready_data %>%
  mutate(
    y_true = ifelse(Depression_status == "Depression", 1, 0),

    pred_DSRSC = ifelse(total_DSRSC >= 15, 1, 0),
    pred_PHQ   = ifelse(total_PHQ   >= 10, 1, 0),
    pred_CDI   = ifelse(total_CDI   >= 20, 1, 0),

    # DASS: 男 >= 4, 女 >= 5
    pred_DASS = case_when(
      Gender == 1 & total_DASS >= 4 ~ 1,
      Gender == 2 & total_DASS >= 5 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

table(clinroc_eval_data$y_true)
# ============================================================
# 3) 固定 cutoff 下的指标表
# ============================================================

clinroc_calc_metrics <- function(y_true, y_pred) {

  tp <- sum(y_true == 1 & y_pred == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  fp <- sum(y_true == 0 & y_pred == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  fn <- sum(y_true == 1 & y_pred == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  tn <- sum(y_true == 0 & y_pred == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  precision <- ifelse((tp + fp) > 0, tp / (tp + fp), NA)
  recall    <- ifelse((tp + fn) > 0, tp / (tp + fn), NA)
  f1        <- ifelse(
    !is.na(precision) && !is.na(recall) && (precision + recall) > 0,
    2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall),
    NA
  )
  accuracy    <- (tp + tn) / (tp + fp + fn + tn)
  sensitivity <- recall
  specificity <- ifelse((tn + fp) > 0, tn / (tn + fp), NA)
  ppv         <- precision
  npv         <- ifelse((tn + fn) > 0, tn / (tn + fn), NA)

  data.frame(
    TP = tp,
    FP = fp,
    FN = fn,
    TN = tn,
    Accuracy = accuracy,
    Sensitivity = sensitivity,
    Specificity = specificity,
    PPV = ppv,
    NPV = npv,
    F1 = f1
  )
}

clinroc_metrics_DSRSC <- clinroc_calc_metrics(clinroc_eval_data$y_true, clinroc_eval_data$pred_DSRSC)
clinroc_metrics_PHQ   <- clinroc_calc_metrics(clinroc_eval_data$y_true, clinroc_eval_data$pred_PHQ)
clinroc_metrics_CDI   <- clinroc_calc_metrics(clinroc_eval_data$y_true, clinroc_eval_data$pred_CDI)
clinroc_metrics_DASS  <- clinroc_calc_metrics(clinroc_eval_data$y_true, clinroc_eval_data$pred_DASS)

clinroc_metrics_DSRSC$Measure <- "DSRSC"
clinroc_metrics_PHQ$Measure   <- "PHQ-9"
clinroc_metrics_CDI$Measure   <- "CDI"
clinroc_metrics_DASS$Measure  <- "DASS"

clinroc_cutoff_metrics <- bind_rows(
  clinroc_metrics_DSRSC,
  clinroc_metrics_PHQ,
  clinroc_metrics_CDI,
  clinroc_metrics_DASS
) %>%
  select(Measure, TP, FP, FN, TN, Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity, PPV, NPV, F1)

print(clinroc_cutoff_metrics)
# ============================================================
# 4) ROC / AUC（基于连续总分）
# ============================================================

clinroc_obj_DSRSC <- roc(
  response = clinroc_eval_data$y_true,
  predictor = clinroc_eval_data$total_DSRSC,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)

clinroc_obj_PHQ <- roc(
  response = clinroc_eval_data$y_true,
  predictor = clinroc_eval_data$total_PHQ,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)

clinroc_obj_CDI <- roc(
  response = clinroc_eval_data$y_true,
  predictor = clinroc_eval_data$total_CDI,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)

clinroc_obj_DASS <- roc(
  response = clinroc_eval_data$y_true,
  predictor = clinroc_eval_data$total_DASS,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)

clinroc_auc_table <- data.frame(
  Measure = c("DSRSC", "PHQ-9", "CDI", "DASS"),
  AUC = c(
    as.numeric(auc(clinroc_obj_DSRSC)),
    as.numeric(auc(clinroc_obj_PHQ)),
    as.numeric(auc(clinroc_obj_CDI)),
    as.numeric(auc(clinroc_obj_DASS))
  )
)

print(clinroc_auc_table)
# ============================================================
# 5) 合并表格结果
# ============================================================

clinroc_summary_table <- clinroc_cutoff_metrics %>%
  left_join(clinroc_auc_table, by = "Measure") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity, PPV, NPV, F1, AUC), ~ round(.x, 3))
  )

print(clinroc_summary_table)

openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  clinroc_summary_table,
  here("OUTPUT", "Clinical_Diagnosis_F1_AUC_Summary.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("✔ 已导出：OUTPUT/Clinical_Diagnosis_F1_AUC_Summary.xlsx\n")

# ============================================================
# 5.1) 新增：导出适合 Word 三线表的“百分比呈现”表
#       —— 对应你现在论文里的 Table 1 样式
# ============================================================

clinroc_total_n <- nrow(clinroc_eval_data)

clinroc_percent_table <- clinroc_cutoff_metrics %>%
  mutate(
    `Clinical Depression (Positive)`     = round(TP / clinroc_total_n * 100, 1),
    `Clinical Depression (Negative)`     = round(FN / clinroc_total_n * 100, 1),
    `Clinical Non-depression (Positive)` = round(FP / clinroc_total_n * 100, 1),
    `Clinical Non-depression (Negative)` = round(TN / clinroc_total_n * 100, 1),
    `F1 score` = round(F1, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Measure,
    `Clinical Depression (Positive)`,
    `Clinical Depression (Negative)`,
    `Clinical Non-depression (Positive)`,
    `Clinical Non-depression (Negative)`,
    `F1 score`
  )

print(clinroc_percent_table)

openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  clinroc_percent_table,
  here("OUTPUT", "Clinical_Diagnosis_Percent_Table.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("✔ 已导出：OUTPUT/Clinical_Diagnosis_Percent_Table.xlsx\n")

# ============================================================
# 6) ROC 数据整理
# ============================================================

clinroc_make_curve_df <- function(roc_obj, measure_name) {
  data.frame(
    FPR = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
    TPR = roc_obj$sensitivities,
    Measure = measure_name
  )
}

clinroc_curve_df <- bind_rows(
  clinroc_make_curve_df(clinroc_obj_DSRSC, "DSRSC"),
  clinroc_make_curve_df(clinroc_obj_PHQ,   "PHQ-9"),
  clinroc_make_curve_df(clinroc_obj_CDI,   "CDI"),
  clinroc_make_curve_df(clinroc_obj_DASS,  "DASS")
)

clinroc_auc_labels <- clinroc_auc_table %>%
  mutate(
    curve_label = paste0(Measure, " (AUC = ", sprintf("%.3f", AUC), ")")
  )

clinroc_curve_df <- clinroc_curve_df %>%
  left_join(clinroc_auc_labels, by = "Measure")
# ============================================================
# 7) 固定 cutoff / 固定规则 对应的 ROC 点
# ============================================================

clinroc_fixed_points <- clinroc_cutoff_metrics %>%
  mutate(
    FPR = 1 - Specificity,
    TPR = Sensitivity,
    fixed_rule_label = c(
      "DSRSC cutoff = 15",
      "PHQ-9 cutoff = 10",
      "CDI cutoff = 20",
      "DASS: M>=4, F>=5"
    )
  )

print(clinroc_fixed_points)
# ============================================================
# 8) 四宫格 ROC（每张图加固定 cutoff 点）
# ============================================================

clinroc_plot_one <- function(curve_data, point_data, measure_name) {

  this_curve <- curve_data %>% filter(Measure == measure_name)
  this_point <- point_data %>% filter(Measure == measure_name)
  this_auc   <- clinroc_auc_labels %>% filter(Measure == measure_name) %>% pull(curve_label)

  ggplot(this_curve, aes(x = FPR, y = TPR)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, color = "#2b8cbe") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(
      data = this_point,
      aes(x = FPR, y = TPR),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      shape = 21,
      size = 3.2,
      stroke = 1,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = this_point,
      aes(x = FPR, y = TPR, label = fixed_rule_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3.2,
      nudge_y = 0.04,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(
      title = this_auc,
      x = "1 - Specificity",
      y = "Sensitivity"
    ) +
    papaja::theme_apa(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
}

clinroc_panel_DSRSC <- clinroc_plot_one(clinroc_curve_df, clinroc_fixed_points, "DSRSC")
clinroc_panel_PHQ   <- clinroc_plot_one(clinroc_curve_df, clinroc_fixed_points, "PHQ-9")
clinroc_panel_CDI   <- clinroc_plot_one(clinroc_curve_df, clinroc_fixed_points, "CDI")
clinroc_panel_DASS  <- clinroc_plot_one(clinroc_curve_df, clinroc_fixed_points, "DASS")

clinroc_four_panel_plot <- (clinroc_panel_DSRSC | clinroc_panel_PHQ) /
  (clinroc_panel_CDI | clinroc_panel_DASS) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "ROC Curves for Four Depression Questionnaires",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16)
    )
  )

clinroc_four_panel_plot

ggsave(
  filename = here("FIGURE", "Clinical_Diagnosis_ROC_FourPanels_WithFixedPoints.png"),
  plot = clinroc_four_panel_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 400,
  bg = "white"
)

cat("✔ 已生成：FIGURE/Clinical_Diagnosis_ROC_FourPanels_WithFixedPoints.png\n")
# ============================================================
# ============================================================
# 9) 一张图画四条 ROC 曲线 + 固定 cutoff 点（美化版）
#    —— 图上只保留点，不直接堆文字
# ============================================================

clinroc_all_in_one_plot <- ggplot(
  clinroc_curve_df,
  aes(x = FPR, y = TPR, color = curve_label)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1, intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = clinroc_fixed_points,
    aes(x = FPR, y = TPR),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    size = 3.8,
    stroke = 1.1,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "ROC Curves for Four Depression Questionnaires",
    subtitle = "Open circles indicate the predefined cutoff points.",
    x = "1 - Specificity",
    y = "Sensitivity",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  papaja::theme_apa(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    legend.position = c(0.68, 0.22),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

clinroc_all_in_one_plot

ggsave(
  filename = here("FIGURE", "Clinical_Diagnosis_ROC_OnePanel_WithFixedPoints.png"),
  plot = clinroc_all_in_one_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 400,
  bg = "white"
)

cat("✔ 已生成：FIGURE/Clinical_Diagnosis_ROC_OnePanel_WithFixedPoints.png\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5.1) 按老师要求重新输出：
#      - 百分比列分别按 Clinical depression / Clinical non-depression / Total 计算
#      - 同时报告 Sensitivity, % (95% CI) 和 Specificity, % (95% CI)
#      - 另导出一个 counts 核对表
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# A. 小工具：计算比例的精确95%CI（binom.test）
# ------------------------------------------------------------
clinroc_prop_ci <- function(x, n, conf.level = 0.95) {
  if (is.na(n) || n == 0) {
    return(c(est = NA, low = NA, high = NA))
  }

  bt <- binom.test(x, n, conf.level = conf.level)

  c(
    est  = unname(bt$estimate),
    low  = bt$conf.int[1],
    high = bt$conf.int[2]
  )
}

clinroc_format_pct_ci <- function(x, n, digits = 1) {
  ci <- clinroc_prop_ci(x, n)
  sprintf(
    paste0("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f, %.", digits, "f)"),
    ci["est"] * 100,
    ci["low"] * 100,
    ci["high"] * 100
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# B. 总体样本量（这三个分母是老师这次最关心的）
# ------------------------------------------------------------
clinroc_dep_n    <- sum(clinroc_eval_data$y_true == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
clinroc_nondep_n <- sum(clinroc_eval_data$y_true == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
clinroc_total_n  <- nrow(clinroc_eval_data)

cat("\n真实抑郁人数 =", clinroc_dep_n,
    "\n真实非抑郁人数 =", clinroc_nondep_n,
    "\n总样本量 =", clinroc_total_n, "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# C. 定义一个函数：针对每个量表生成
#    1) 老师要的百分比表（两行：Positive / Negative）
#    2) 你自己核对的 counts 表（TP/FP/FN/TN）
# ------------------------------------------------------------
clinroc_build_teacher_output <- function(y_true, y_pred, measure_name,
                                         dep_n, nondep_n, total_n) {

  # 如有缺失，先剔除
  keep <- complete.cases(y_true, y_pred)
  y_true <- y_true[keep]
  y_pred <- y_pred[keep]

  tp <- sum(y_true == 1 & y_pred == 1)
  fp <- sum(y_true == 0 & y_pred == 1)
  fn <- sum(y_true == 1 & y_pred == 0)
  tn <- sum(y_true == 0 & y_pred == 0)

  # 百分比（老师要求的分母）
  dep_pos_pct    <- round(tp / dep_n * 100, 1)
  dep_neg_pct    <- round(fn / dep_n * 100, 1)
  nondep_pos_pct <- round(fp / nondep_n * 100, 1)
  nondep_neg_pct <- round(tn / nondep_n * 100, 1)

  total_pos_pct  <- round((tp + fp) / total_n * 100, 1)
  total_neg_pct  <- round((fn + tn) / total_n * 100, 1)

  # Sensitivity / Specificity + 95%CI
  sens_str <- clinroc_format_pct_ci(tp, tp + fn, digits = 1)
  spec_str <- clinroc_format_pct_ci(tn, tn + fp, digits = 1)

  # 1) 老师要的表：两行
  percent_table <- data.frame(
    Measure = c(measure_name, ""),
    `Scale results` = c("Positive", "Negative"),
    `Clinical depression, %` = c(dep_pos_pct, dep_neg_pct),
    `Clinical non-depression, %` = c(nondep_pos_pct, nondep_neg_pct),
    `Total, %` = c(total_pos_pct, total_neg_pct),
    `Sensitivity, % (95% CI)` = c(sens_str, ""),
    `Specificity, % (95% CI)` = c(spec_str, ""),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  # 2) 你自己核对用的人数表
  counts_table <- data.frame(
    Measure = measure_name,
    TP = tp,
    FP = fp,
    FN = fn,
    TN = tn,
    Depression_n = tp + fn,
    Non_depression_n = fp + tn,
    Positive_total = tp + fp,
    Negative_total = fn + tn,
    Total_N = tp + fp + fn + tn,
    Sensitivity = round(tp / (tp + fn), 4),
    Specificity = round(tn / (tn + fp), 4),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  list(
    percent_table = percent_table,
    counts_table = counts_table
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# D. 逐个量表生成
# ------------------------------------------------------------
clinroc_out_DSRSC <- clinroc_build_teacher_output(
  y_true = clinroc_eval_data$y_true,
  y_pred = clinroc_eval_data$pred_DSRSC,
  measure_name = "DSRSC",
  dep_n = clinroc_dep_n,
  nondep_n = clinroc_nondep_n,
  total_n = clinroc_total_n
)

clinroc_out_PHQ <- clinroc_build_teacher_output(
  y_true = clinroc_eval_data$y_true,
  y_pred = clinroc_eval_data$pred_PHQ,
  measure_name = "PHQ-9",
  dep_n = clinroc_dep_n,
  nondep_n = clinroc_nondep_n,
  total_n = clinroc_total_n
)

clinroc_out_CDI <- clinroc_build_teacher_output(
  y_true = clinroc_eval_data$y_true,
  y_pred = clinroc_eval_data$pred_CDI,
  measure_name = "CDI",
  dep_n = clinroc_dep_n,
  nondep_n = clinroc_nondep_n,
  total_n = clinroc_total_n
)

clinroc_out_DASS <- clinroc_build_teacher_output(
  y_true = clinroc_eval_data$y_true,
  y_pred = clinroc_eval_data$pred_DASS,
  measure_name = "DASS",
  dep_n = clinroc_dep_n,
  nondep_n = clinroc_nondep_n,
  total_n = clinroc_total_n
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# E. 合并成最终输出表
# ------------------------------------------------------------
clinroc_teacher_percent_table <- bind_rows(
  clinroc_out_DSRSC$percent_table,
  clinroc_out_PHQ$percent_table,
  clinroc_out_CDI$percent_table,
  clinroc_out_DASS$percent_table
)

clinroc_teacher_counts_table <- bind_rows(
  clinroc_out_DSRSC$counts_table,
  clinroc_out_PHQ$counts_table,
  clinroc_out_CDI$counts_table,
  clinroc_out_DASS$counts_table
)

# 把列名改成老师想看的样子（把 n/N 放到列名里）
names(clinroc_teacher_percent_table)[3] <- paste0(
  "Clinical depression (n = ", clinroc_dep_n, "), %"
)
names(clinroc_teacher_percent_table)[4] <- paste0(
  "Clinical non-depression (n = ", clinroc_nondep_n, "), %"
)
names(clinroc_teacher_percent_table)[5] <- paste0(
  "Total (N = ", clinroc_total_n, "), %"
)

cat("\n===== 老师要求的百分比表 =====\n")
print(clinroc_teacher_percent_table)

cat("\n===== 核对用 counts 表 =====\n")
print(clinroc_teacher_counts_table)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# F. 导出 Excel（一个文件两个 sheet）
# ------------------------------------------------------------
wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "Teacher_percent_table")
writeData(wb, "Teacher_percent_table", clinroc_teacher_percent_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Counts_check")
writeData(wb, "Counts_check", clinroc_teacher_counts_table)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  here("OUTPUT", "Clinical_Diagnosis_Teacher_Table.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("✔ 已导出：OUTPUT/Clinical_Diagnosis_Teacher_Table.xlsx\n")

```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Faceted ROC：共享坐标轴 + cutoff / optimal（改良版）
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pROC)
library(papaja)
library(here)
library(grid)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) ROC 曲线数据
# ------------------------------------------------------------
clinroc_grid_curve_df <- bind_rows(
  clinroc_make_curve_df(clinroc_obj_DSRSC, "DSRSC"),
  clinroc_make_curve_df(clinroc_obj_PHQ,   "PHQ-9"),
  clinroc_make_curve_df(clinroc_obj_CDI,   "CDI"),
  clinroc_make_curve_df(clinroc_obj_DASS,  "DASS")
)

# 固定量表顺序
clinroc_measure_levels <- c("DSRSC", "PHQ-9", "CDI", "DASS")

clinroc_grid_curve_df <- clinroc_grid_curve_df %>%
  mutate(
    Measure = factor(Measure, levels = clinroc_measure_levels)
  )

clinroc_grid_auc_df <- clinroc_auc_table %>%
  mutate(
    Measure = factor(Measure, levels = clinroc_measure_levels),
    facet_title = paste0(as.character(Measure), " (AUC = ", sprintf("%.3f", AUC), ")")
  )

# 关键：把 facet_title 也设成固定顺序的 factor
clinroc_grid_auc_df <- clinroc_grid_auc_df %>%
  mutate(
    facet_title = factor(
      facet_title,
      levels = facet_title[match(clinroc_measure_levels, Measure)]
    )
  )

clinroc_grid_curve_df <- clinroc_grid_curve_df %>%
  left_join(clinroc_grid_auc_df, by = "Measure")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) cutoff 点
# ------------------------------------------------------------
clinroc_grid_cutoff_df <- clinroc_cutoff_metrics %>%
  mutate(
    Measure = factor(Measure, levels = clinroc_measure_levels),
    FPR = 1 - Specificity,
    TPR = Sensitivity,
    point_type = "cutoff"
  ) %>%
  left_join(clinroc_grid_auc_df, by = "Measure")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) optimal 点（Youden）
# ------------------------------------------------------------
clinroc_grid_get_optimal <- function(roc_obj, measure_name) {
  best_coords <- pROC::coords(
    roc_obj,
    x = "best",
    best.method = "youden",
    ret = c("specificity", "sensitivity"),
    transpose = FALSE
  )

  data.frame(
    Measure = measure_name,
    FPR = 1 - as.numeric(best_coords["specificity"]),
    TPR = as.numeric(best_coords["sensitivity"]),
    point_type = "optimal"
  )
}

clinroc_grid_optimal_df <- bind_rows(
  clinroc_grid_get_optimal(clinroc_obj_DSRSC, "DSRSC"),
  clinroc_grid_get_optimal(clinroc_obj_PHQ,   "PHQ-9"),
  clinroc_grid_get_optimal(clinroc_obj_CDI,   "CDI"),
  clinroc_grid_get_optimal(clinroc_obj_DASS,  "DASS")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Measure = factor(Measure, levels = clinroc_measure_levels)
  ) %>%
  left_join(clinroc_grid_auc_df, by = "Measure")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) 合并点 + 为标签设置“更远”的偏移
# ------------------------------------------------------------
clinroc_grid_points_df <- bind_rows(
  clinroc_grid_cutoff_df %>%
    select(Measure, facet_title, FPR, TPR, point_type),
  clinroc_grid_optimal_df %>%
    select(Measure, facet_title, FPR, TPR, point_type)
) %>%
  mutate(
    label_x = ifelse(point_type == "cutoff", FPR + 0.07, FPR - 0.10),
    label_y = ifelse(point_type == "cutoff", TPR + 0.05, TPR - 0.07)
  )

# 避免文字跑出边界
clinroc_grid_points_df <- clinroc_grid_points_df %>%
  mutate(
    label_x = pmin(pmax(label_x, 0.03), 0.97),
    label_y = pmin(pmax(label_y, 0.03), 0.97)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) 一个 ggplot 对象，用 facet_wrap 共享坐标轴
# ------------------------------------------------------------
clinroc_grid_plot <- ggplot(
  clinroc_grid_curve_df,
  aes(x = FPR, y = TPR)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.15, color = "#2b8cbe") +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1, intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = clinroc_grid_points_df %>% filter(point_type == "cutoff"),
    aes(x = FPR, y = TPR),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    size = 3.5,
    stroke = 1,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = clinroc_grid_points_df %>% filter(point_type == "optimal"),
    aes(x = FPR, y = TPR),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 24,
    size = 4.0,
    stroke = 1,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # 用 label 而不是 text，给白底，避免压在线上看不清
  geom_label(
    data = clinroc_grid_points_df,
    aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = point_type),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.0,
    label.size = 0,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ facet_title, ncol = 2) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
    labels = c("0.00", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1.00")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
    labels = c("0.00", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1.00")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "ROC Curves for Four Depression scales",
    x = "False Positive Rate",
    y = "True Positive Rate"
  ) +
  papaja::theme_apa(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 15),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.8, "lines"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 12)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 12))
  )

clinroc_grid_plot

ggsave(
  filename = here("FIGURE", "Clinical_Diagnosis_ROC_Faceted_Cutoff_Optimal.png"),
  plot = clinroc_grid_plot,
  width = 11.5,
  height = 8.8,
  dpi = 400,
  bg = "white"
)

cat("✔ 已生成：FIGURE/Clinical_Diagnosis_ROC_Faceted_Cutoff_Optimal.png\n")

```
